name: Rin
source:
"I don't know. Is there anything interesting?"

Alongside his twin brother, he was active in child roles and got famous, hence why he's unable to tend a normal school and was forced to attend the academy.

He loves to talk about love and, when he finds a potential couple, he wants to matchmake them. The handcuffs he and his brother carry are used for capturing when the couple is discovered.

Hobby: Matchmaking
Favorite Food: Sushi (without wasabi)
Dislikes: Spicy food, cinnamon

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041205190632/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char07.htm]official website[/url]]
